translation: Pungent in flavor, slightly cold, non-toxic. It chiefly treats wind-itching of the body, headache, cough with counterflow, injury to the lung, lung wilting (feiwei), stops vexation, sends qi downward, small abscesses and swelling, and yin (genital) ...; it may be made into a rubbing powder. Its leaves chiefly treat wind-itching and may be boiled for bathing.
